$comment: Machine-readable index of the AWP v1alpha4 conformance suite. Each invalid case violates exactly one rule; `code` and `path` identify the expected diagnostic (see schema/README.md).

tests.rule: YAML features without a JSON equivalent (custom tags) MUST be rejected.
YAML mapping keys MUST be strings.
A document that is not well-formed YAML is rejected.
apiVersion is REQUIRED.
metadata is REQUIRED.
spec is REQUIRED.
apiVersion MUST name a supported version.
kind MUST be Workflow, Agent or Policy.
Extension fields are placed in an extensions object; an x- field on the object itself is unknown.
Keys of extensions start with x-.
Agents with protocol a2a belong to the a2a profile.
Steps with type approval belong to the governance profile.
spec.audit belongs to the audit profile.
A field of a profile the implementation does not support MUST be rejected naming field and profile (spec.approval, governance).
spec.risk.level high or critical belongs to the governance profile.
Steps with type input belong to the interaction profile.
spec.mcpServers belongs to the mcp profile.
Policy manifests belong to the governance profile.
spec.signature belongs to the security profile.
Only the prefix x- marks an extension; x_foo and X-foo are unknown fields.
Unknown fields MUST be rejected (metadata).
Unknown fields MUST be rejected (nested in a list entry).
Unknown fields MUST be rejected (top level; status is reserved, not unknown).
Identifiers MUST be unique within their list (agents).
Identifiers MUST be unique within their list (rules).
metadata.name MUST be a DNS-1123 label.
Identifiers MUST match ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,62}$.
metadata.name MUST be a DNS-1123 label (lowercase).
SemVer forbids leading zeros in numeric identifiers.
spec.version MUST be a SemVer 2.0.0 string.
Durations use the units ms, s, m, h, d, w, y.
A duration MUST be greater than zero.
Dates are RFC 3339 full-date values; 2027-02-30 does not exist.
Dates are RFC 3339 full-date values.
Digest hex is lowercase.
A sha256 digest has 64 lowercase hex characters.
No functions in expressions.
env values are expression-enabled; other syntax is rejected.
No operators in expressions.
References are inputs, steps.<id>.outputs and execution only.
An expression must be closed.
forEach.* references MUST only be used in task and env of a step that declares forEach.
Step references are only valid inside a step.
A reference to a non-existent step is rejected.
steps.<id> MUST only be used in a step that depends on <id>.
Governance fields are spec fields; metadata.owner is unknown.
Label keys MUST match ^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9._/-]{0,127}$.
risk.level is one of low, medium, high, critical.
Labels are a map of strings.
Label values have at most 63 characters (Kubernetes label syntax).
spec.owner is REQUIRED.
spec.version is REQUIRED.
spec.owner is an object; the string shorthand of v1alpha1 is removed.
owner as an object REQUIRES team.
concurrencyPolicy and startingDeadline belong to schedule triggers only.
cron is a 5-field cron expression.
event triggers REQUIRE source and eventType.
concurrencyPolicy is allow, forbid or replace.
schedule triggers REQUIRE cron.
startingDeadline is a duration.
type is manual, schedule or event.
default MUST match type.
pattern is an ECMA-262 regular expression.
default MUST NOT be set when required is true.
type is string, integer, number, boolean, object, array or artifact.
An inline agent REQUIRES model.
promptRef MUST NOT be combined with instructions.
ref.version is an exact SemVer version, no ranges.
An agent reference MUST NOT contain instructions.
An agent reference MUST NOT contain model.
ref REQUIRES name and version.
model.approval.status is approved, pending, rejected or revoked.
model REQUIRES provider and name.
A remote agent endpoint is an HTTPS URL.
A remote agent MUST NOT contain model.
A remote agent REQUIRES endpoint.
protocol MUST be a2a.
MCP server names are referenced by tool sources and must be unique.
The url of an MCP server MUST use https.
url is REQUIRED for streamable-http.
transport is stdio or streamable-http.
A builtin tool source REQUIRES name.
An mcp tool source REQUIRES server.
Permission keys are action identifiers with at least two segments.
Only a final segment may be the wildcard *.
Groups MUST NOT contain other groups.
A group identifier MUST be a valid action identifier.
Fields of command steps are not allowed in agent steps.
An agent step REQUIRES agent.
An approval step has no requiredFor; it applies only at workflow level.
An approval step has no separationOfDuties; it applies only at workflow level.
An approval step REQUIRES approval.
A command step has no agent.
A command step REQUIRES command.
retries is a non-negative integer.
Output names match ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,62}$, so that they are file names and expression keys.
retries MUST NOT exceed budget.resources.maxRetries if set.
type is agent, command or approval.
env keys are environment variable names.
The runtime MUST reject a workflow whose steps contain a cycle.
A dependsOn entry that names a non-existent step is rejected.
The runtime MUST reject a duplicate step id.
A step that depends on itself is a cycle.
Outputs not declared in outputs MUST NOT be referenced.
An agent that names a non-existent agent is rejected.
Environment variables with the prefix AWP_ are reserved for the runtime.
forEach.concurrency MUST NOT exceed the effective budget.resources.maxConcurrency.
An input referenced by forEach.items MUST have type array.
forEach.items MUST only reference a step this step depends on.
forEach.items is exactly one reference to an input or a step output.
forEach.maxItems is REQUIRED.
forEach is not allowed on approval steps.
All limits MUST be positive.
Unknown budget fields are rejected.
All limits MUST be positive.
All limits MUST be positive.
humanInput.onTimeout is return or fail.
Answer fields are primitive (string, number, integer, boolean).
default matches answerSchema.
An input step has no agent.
An input step REQUIRES input.
answerers is REQUIRED; nobody else may answer.
required names fields of answerSchema.properties.
onTimeout useDefault REQUIRES default.
promptRef MUST NOT be combined with instructions.
agents/workflow belong to kind Workflow only.
An Agent manifest has no spec.workflow (unknown field).
An Agent manifest REQUIRES spec.model.
Under the governance profile Workflow and Agent REQUIRE spec.classification.
Data classes are public, internal, confidential, personal, restricted, sensitive, secret.
externalTransfer is allow or deny.
requirements.approvalStatus uses the model approval statuses.
allow is a boolean.
permissions.default is allow or deny.
network.egress is allow or deny.
permissions.tools entries REQUIRE allow.
An approver has exactly one of role or user.
An approver has exactly one of role or user.
onTimeout is reject or fail.
minApprovals is a positive integer.
requiredFor lists action keys.
Separation-of-duties rules are the defined rules only.
Credential-named fields are rejected anywhere outside x- extensions, also inside free-form values.
Fields named token, password, apiKey, secret or privateKey with a literal value are rejected (here: unknown field in auth).
A remote agent credential is scoped to the agent id.
The default scope is none.
The scope of the secret MUST include the consumer.
A secretRef MUST name a secret declared in spec.secrets.
A secret declaration REQUIRES name and source.
Each environment REQUIRES autonomy.
autonomy is unrestricted, controlled, approval-required or prohibited.
include entries name a Policy by name and exact version.
Policy shorthands are booleans.
Unknown shorthands are rejected.
Policy rules can only restrict: effect is deny or requireApproval.
A Policy REQUIRES rules.
approval is REQUIRED for requireApproval.
A rule REQUIRES when.
A condition has at least one attribute.
in and notIn take lists.
actor.type is agent, human, runtime or system.
Classification values in conditions are data classes.
gt, gte, lt, lte are for data.classification and risk.level only.
Each condition attribute maps to an operator object; the plain-value shorthand of v1alpha1 is removed.
Only the defined attributes may be used in conditions.
If spec.integrity.digest is present, runtimes verify it and reject on mismatch.
Under the security profile command step images MUST be pinned by digest.
Under the security profile container images MUST be pinned by digest.
audit.integrity.mode is none, hash-chain or signed.
audit.payload is metadata or full.
retention.duration is a duration.
workflowRef.version is a semantic version.
A WorkflowRun has no governance fields; they belong to the workflow.
metadata has name or generateName.
spec.workflowRef is REQUIRED.
Manifests are representable as JSON and implementations accept JSON.
A file may contain several YAML documents; each is an independent manifest.
Minimal Workflow of the specification (hello); spec.classification is only REQUIRED under the governance profile.
status and metadata fields populated by an object store are accepted and ignored.
A manifest using only core fields is valid for a validator that supports only the core profile.
Fields starting with x- may appear in any object and are ignored.
Durations use units ms, s, m, h, d, w, y and may be combined.
The allowed references are inputs.<name>, steps.<id>.outputs.<name>, execution.id, execution.environment.
labels and annotations are string maps with Kubernetes key syntax.
A schedule trigger may set concurrencyPolicy and startingDeadline.
manual, schedule and event triggers.
Input declarations with all types; default matches type.
Agent reference with exact version and digest.
Remote A2A agent with HTTPS endpoint and a scoped secretRef.
Groups map concrete actions to well-known actions; groups hold only concrete actions.
Command steps receive values through env; the command text has no expressions.
A step may reference outputs of steps it depends on transitively.
A command step declares outputs whose names are valid file names in $AWP_OUTPUTS.
An agent or command step MAY iterate over an array input or a step output with forEach.
Budgets on workflow, agent and step; retries do not exceed maxRetries.
An agent with humanInput may ask a person during its step.
humanInput is also allowed in an Agent manifest.
Without answerSchema the answer is free text.
An input step asks named answerers, waits up to its timeout and provides the output answer.
A complete Agent manifest.
An Agent may use promptRef instead of instructions.
Data policy, residency, processing and model policy.
All permission fields, wildcard keys and resource scopes.
Workflow approval, approval step and separation of duties.
Environments with autonomy levels.
Policy shorthands and policy includes.
Policy manifest with requireApproval and deny rules.
All condition attributes and operators; ordering operators on ordered attributes.
The digest covers apiVersion, kind, metadata.name and spec without integrity, signature and provenance; namespace, labels, annotations and status do not change it.
spec.integrity.digest matches the JCS digest of the manifest without integrity, signature and provenance.
Under the security profile images are pinned by digest.
Audit configuration.
A WorkflowRun may use generateName; validators ignore status written by the runtime.
A WorkflowRun requests one execution of a workflow with inputs and an environment.
when is allowed on agent, command, approval, input and workflow steps.
Conditions combine exists(), in with literal lists, comparisons and boolean operators.
Path segments after the output name select into the output parsed as JSON; a transitive dependency may be read.
A workflow step starts a child workflow with expression-enabled inputs, waits for it and provides executionId and status.
With wait: false the workflow step only starts the child execution.
when MUST parse in the condition grammar.
A condition has at most 512 characters.
steps.<id> in when MUST be a direct or transitive dependency.
<name> in steps.<id>.outputs.<name> MUST be a declared output of <id>.
Path segments __proto__, prototype and constructor MUST be rejected.
Conditions read only inputs, steps.<id>.outputs and execution.environment.
workflow.ref is REQUIRED.
forEach is not allowed on a workflow step.
A workflow step declares no outputs other than executionId and status.
workflow.ref is a DNS-1123 label like metadata.name.
A workflow step has no agent.
workflow.inputs values are expression-enabled; other syntax is rejected.
